surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the sequential exposure of the surface to a metal–organic precursor (trimethylaluminum, TMA) and a reactant (H2O). The ALD process leads to the formation of Al-OH surface species, which are then reacted with the precursor to form Al-O-Al bonds, with the release of byproducts such as CH4 and methanol. The mechanism is described as a self-limiting process with precise control over thickness and homogeneity.
